question: Employers whose skill needs align with our curriculum
cypher:
MATCH (col:College {name: $college})-[:IN_MARKET]->(r:Region)<-[:IN_MARKET]-(emp:Employer)-[:HIRES_FOR]->(occ:Occupation)-[:REQUIRES_SKILL]->(sk:Skill)<-[:DEVELOPS]-(course:Course {college: $college})
RETURN emp.name AS name, emp.sector AS sector, emp.description AS description,
       emp.website AS website,
       collect(DISTINCT occ.title) AS occupations,
       count(DISTINCT sk) AS matching_skills,
       collect(DISTINCT sk.name) AS skills
ORDER BY matching_skills DESC
interpretation: This query identifies all employers in College of the Desert's regional labor market whose skill requirements overlap with skills developed in College of the Desert's courses, ranked by the number of matching skills to highlight the strongest curriculum alignment opportunities.

cypher: MATCH (c:Course {college: $college}) WHERE c.is_cte = true AND (toLower(c.department) CONTAINS 'health' OR toLower(c.name) CONTAINS 'health' OR toLower(c.description) CONTAINS 'health' OR toLower(c.department) CONTAINS 'medical' OR toLower(c.department) CONTAINS 'nursing' OR toLower(c.department) CONTAINS 'dental' OR toLower(c.department) CONTAINS 'pharmacy' OR toLower(c.department) CONTAINS 'clinical' OR toLower(c.department) CONTAINS 'radiolog') RETURN c.name AS name, c.code AS code, c.description AS description, c.learning_outcomes AS learning_outcomes, c.course_objectives AS course_objectives, c.skill_mappings AS skill_mappings ORDER BY c.code
interpretation: This query finds all officially classified Career and Technical Education (CTE) courses at Foothill College that are related to healthcare fields — including health, medical, nursing, dental, pharmacy, clinical, and radiology programs — to help identify pathways into healthcare careers.
